notes: Buyer: Head of Product (Aisha Patel) and ML Lead (Devon Chu). CIO looped in for security.
Primary motivation: reduce per-query cost and get predictable latency for chat-support and search features.
Currently using OpenAI + vendor-managed embeddings; goal to migrate to Redwood Hosted first, then Dedicated (VPC) for predictable SLOs.
Key asks: API compatibility (minimal client changes), prompt parity vs OpenAI GPT-4-like outputs, embedding cosine stability, model fallback behavior.
POC scope: migrate 10k support transcripts + product docs, run A/B vs OpenAI for NPS bot answers and search recall (100k query sim).
Tech constraints: must support SSO (Okta SAML), KMS integration for envelope keys, and per-route audit logs retained 1 year.
Dev note: saw small regressions on list enumerations — likely due to decoding defaults. SE proposed prompt engineering + temperature lock and Redwood model variant with deterministic sampling.
Customer asked about compat layer — wants minimal SDK churn; asked about a thin shim to translate openai.Chat format to Redwood endpoints.
Legal asked for export control and data residency language; they require EU data to stay in eu-1 region once Dedicated is provisioned.
Customer is cost-sensitive but values reliability: target 99.95% uptime, p50 latency < 60ms for chat, p95 < 250ms under steady load.

notes_short_summary: Mid-market product analytics SaaS evaluating Hosted→Dedicated. POC underway to verify prompt parity, embeddings, and cost. Legal and SOC2 items are gating Dedicated pilot.
migration_notes: Plan: two-phase migration — 1) Hosted API POC to validate parity and costs, 2) Dedicated pilot with VPC and KMS.
Compatibility: customer insists on OpenAI-compatible shim; Redwood SDK should map chat, function-calling, and streaming with minimal changes.
Regression mitigation: maintain 'baseline' test-set of 500 prompts; automated eval harness to compare outputs (ROUGE/EM + human spot-check).
Embeddings: need cosine alignment threshold; if drift > 0.03 on sample set, require retraining or config change before rollout.
Routing: want automatic fallback to smaller model when Dedicated capacity saturated; Redwood's smart routing policy discussed — must preserve prompt identity for auditing.
Escalations: open ticket INF-4187 to investigate tokenization edge-case causing enumerations issue.
